answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can bridge into the marketplace, and let reputation act as a lantern that makes each agent's history visible to peers. A sybil operator who spins up many hollow identities must lock real funds behind each one, and misbehavior burns the stake, so creating a hundred fake agents costs a hundred deposits while honest agents keep theirs. This turns cheap identity forgery into an expensive, traceable gamble.
